slides.title: The kids are home for 2 weeks. Make a chore chart before day one.
Two jobs per kid, per day
slides.body: More than two and the chart gets ignored by day three. Including by us.

slides.title: Use pictures for little ones
slides.body: A sock for laundry, a plate for dishes. No reading needed.

slides.title: Put it at their eye level
slides.body: Fridge bottom, not the top. If they can see it, they can check it.

slides.title: Pick a reward together
slides.body: A movie night, extra screen time, choosing dinner. Their pick, your yes.

slides.title: A chart does the reminding, so you don't have to.
Want a chart ready to print?
slides.body: Grab the Tidy Brain Printable Pack for the family chore chart and reward menu. Link in bio.
